messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT (PD-INC-4382): gpu-node-rt23 reported KERNEL_PANIC -> kubelet=NotReady, heartbeats lost. Auto-page to eng-oncall.

maria: acked. pulling serial console and kubectl. attaching to host now.

aj: oncall here — checking node allocation & recent deploys. tagging oncall logs.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: escalation policy applied after 2m (primary acked). Notifying secondary.

maria: serial shows early oops: ```[ 1234.567890] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000000
[ 1234.568000] PC is at gpu_pm_suspend+0x1a3/0x2b0```

samir: that trace smells like an NV driver or power-management regression. any recent kernel/drivers pushed to this rack?

aj: quick grep shows a rolling driver update 2h ago to nvidia-driver-525 -> 530 on rack-7 hosts. gpu-node-rt23 is in rack-7 and got the update at 00:45Z.

kira: flagging potential blast radius: 4 active Dedicated jobs on that rack, two belong to high-traffic customers. initiating impact check.

maria: kubelet logs after reboot attempt: ```Mar 15 02:34:40 kubelet[1]: E03015 02:34:40.123456 kubelet_node_status.go:123] Node is not ready: KubeletNotReady: container runtime is down```

aj: node is flapping on boot. serial shows repeated watchdog resets. bootlooping before kubelet fully starts.

samir: let's cordon & drain any surviving nodes in that rack to reduce risk. aj, can you run cordon/drain for gpu-node-rt23?

aj: running: ```kubectl cordon gpu-node-rt23 && kubectl drain gpu-node-rt23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force```

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded: maria (primary). Escalation held.

kira: contacting customer ops to check if any queries from the two high-traffic customers. CCing support.

maria: non-intrusive debug attempt: resetting PCI on GPU via ipmi remote before RMA: ```ipmitool -H host-bmc -U admin -P **** raw 0x06 0x01``` — waiting for response.

aj: eviction completed for pods on node (some restarted elsewhere). Observability: 5% increased latency on embedding service for a minute while pods rescheduled, now back to baseline.

samir: good. if PCI reset doesn't stick, we'll prioritize RMA. opening hardware ticket and patching node for soft-power-cycle.

maria: PCI reset didn't help, serial now shows same oops before watchdog. engaging RMA flow. creating jira HW-RT-912 for replacement and updating the incident channel.

kira: Customer ops reports one support ticket impacted but no SLA breach yet. monitoring, will escalate if errors surface.

aj: handing off to morning oncall (samir) in 20m — leave RMA ticket + serial logs + timeline in the jira.

samir: taking over. summary for handoff: kernel oops after recent driver upgrade on rack-7, node flapping at boot, PCI reset failed, RMA opened HW-RT-912, customer impact limited to short reschedule latency. continuing replacement coordination.

maria: adding recommended mitigation: pause driver rollout for rack-7 and run canary on one spare host. Filing rollback playbook in infra:PATCH-223.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-INC-4382 status: acknowledged, secondary notified, RMA ticket created.

samir: closing channel for now — will update when RMA scheduled or if customer impact changes. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
